commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
source = Path('/workspace/work/sdcorejs-benchmark-20261114/experiment/trials/t10/target/inputs/ticket-v1.json')
capture = Path('/workspace/work/sdcorejs-benchmark-20261114/experiment/trials/t10/capture')
raw = source.read_bytes()
ticket = json.loads(raw)
result = {
    'source': 'inputs/ticket-v1.json',
    'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
    'json_parse': 'valid',
    'ticket_id': ticket['identity']['id'],
    'revision': ticket['revision'],
    'acceptance_criteria_count': len(ticket['acceptance_criteria']),
    'source_criterion_ids': [x['id'] for x in ticket['acceptance_criteria']],
    'comments_count': len(ticket['comments']),
    'attachment_metadata_count': len(ticket['attachments']),
    'attachment_bytes_read': False,
    'application_tests': 'NOT RUN - explicitly prohibited',
    'network_or_tracker_operations': 'NOT RUN'
}
output = json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n'
capture.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(capture / 'source-inspection.txt').write_text(output)
print(output, end='')
PY
